Product:{\"sku\":\"7100099920\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
In a picturesque North American setting with wide open land and clear rivers, a Central European location with green fields between ponds, or a lush East Asian landscape filled with water-flooded rice paddies. Grow your farm, produce goods, and cultivate the agricultural empire of your dreams!

- Grow with Agriculture! 25 Crops to cultivate on your fields

- Branch out into Forestry! Or constructions & farm shops!

- Tend to Livestock! Adorable animals need your care

- Operate 400+ Machines! From 150 real brands

- Mods: Download user-generated & developer-tested content
